description: Verify that DUT does NOT emit ICMP Parameter Problem for malformed IP options when they arrive on a non-first fragment (offset != 0) — options on later fragments should be ignored, not error-reported (RFC 791 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion to ICMPV4_ERROR_02. RFC 791 §3.2 mandates options be parsed only on the first fragment of a datagram; later fragments must not be options-checked. So malformed options on a non-first fragment must NOT produce a Parameter Problem.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: IPv4 fragment
   • offset       != 0   (non-first fragment)
   • IP options   = malformed Internet Timestamp

2. Observation (5 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: nothing — no ICMP Parameter Problem

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any ICMP Parameter Problem within the window.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT emitted a Parameter Problem despite the malformed options being on a non-first fragment. Suggests DUT is parsing options on every fragment, contrary to the spec.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently ignored the bad options on the non-first fragment — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT emitted Parameter Problem for options on a non-first fragment — over-eager parsing
